title: Aureline M5 retirement impact blocker gate
description: Canonical per-domain impact-blocker-gate record minted by the retirement-impact-report and impact-blocker-gate lane over the frozen M5 retired-state matrix. Blocks the closure of a retirement candidate while a live dependency still points at the retiring surface, so the support window can never close over a dangling reference. Records the gate scope a blocker sits in — a bundle still points at the candidate, a tenant still points at the candidate, or a schema / public artifact still points at the candidate. Names the gate scope, binds the affected retirement-candidate reference, the affected dependency-finding reference, the candidate-versus-dependent reference, and the active gate reason so review-packet, support-export, and public-proof surfaces can show a candidate's outstanding blocker list rather than re-deriving the blast radius by hand. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a candidate's closure-blocking dependencies by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
